data_policy.allowed: Development diagnostics and parameter design only
data_policy.forbidden: Existing Final Holdout prediction, gold, failure, or repository-specific tuning

module_threshold_policy: Median top-level indexed module count among failed large-Repository Development cases

E7-A.description: E6 fixed TF-IDF/SBERT 50 plus Symbol/API and Call Graph Top-3

E7-B.description: Keep small and medium repositories at 50; expand only large repositories to 100 before SBERT, while retaining E6 Call Graph

selection_rules.primary_metric: Overall Development Recall@20 paired E7-B minus E7-A
